# --no-commit on init: the base is scaffolded and its paths are staged; the
# commit is left to the caller. The flag leaves the tree without a commit both
# standalone and embedded.

env GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=2
env GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=user.name
env GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=ambient
env GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=user.email
env GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1=ambient@local

exec akb init staged-kb --no-commit
stdout '^Initialized KB "staged-kb" at .*/staged-kb$'
exists staged-kb/.git
exists staged-kb/.agent-kb/akb.yaml

cd staged-kb

# The repository has no commit, and the base's paths wait in the index.
! exec git log --oneline
exec git diff --cached --name-only
stdout '^\.agent-kb/\.gitignore$'
stdout '^\.agent-kb/akb\.yaml$'
stdout '^\.gitignore$'
stdout '^kb/index\.md$'
stdout '^kb/log\.md$'
stdout '^raw/files\.log$'
# The search database is ignored, so it is not staged.
! stdout 'search\.db'
exec git status --porcelain
stdout '^A  kb/index\.md$'

# The embedded layout stages the base's paths in the host index and leaves the
# host history untouched.
cd $WORK
mkdir host
cd host
exec git init -q
cp ../host-wip.txt host.txt
exec git add host.txt
exec git commit -m 'host work'
# Unrelated host work, staged before the base is created.
cp ../host-wip.txt wip.txt
exec git add wip.txt
exec git rev-parse HEAD
cp stdout head-before.txt

exec akb init docs --embed --no-commit
stdout '^Initialized KB "docs" at .*/host/docs$'
stdout '^kb: docs is embedded inside repository .*; akb commits only kb/, raw/, \.agent-kb/$'

exec git rev-parse HEAD
cmp stdout head-before.txt
exec git diff --cached --name-only
stdout '^docs/\.agent-kb/\.gitignore$'
stdout '^docs/\.agent-kb/akb\.yaml$'
stdout '^docs/\.gitignore$'
stdout '^docs/kb/index\.md$'
stdout '^docs/kb/log\.md$'
stdout '^docs/raw/files\.log$'
stdout '^wip\.txt$'
-- host-wip.txt --
Unrelated host work, staged before the base is created.
